stories.title: Shelton, Nakashima Into All-American Montreal Final — Shelton Bleeds Through Semifinal [TIER 1]

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Shelton def. Tien 6-2, 6-3. Nakashima def. Jodar 7-6(3), 6-4.

It's an all-American final in Montreal tonight. Shelton defending his title. Nakashima in his first Masters 1000 final. Not before 8 PM ET. 🇺🇸🇺🇸

#Tennis #ATP #NBO2026

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Shelton took a medical timeout after crashing into an LED ad panel. Bleeding from his elbow and hand. Coach Erin Stubbs demanded the panel be removed.

He still won 6-2, 6-3. That's a defending champion. 🎾

#Tennis #ATP #NBO2026 #Montreal

stories.title: Toronto WTA Final Set — Swiatek vs. Rybakina, Head-to-Head Even at 6-6 [TIER 1]

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Toronto final is set.

Swiatek def. Svitolina 6-3, 1-6, 6-3 (first win vs. Svitolina in three 2026 meetings)
Rybakina def. Gauff 5-7, 6-2, 6-2 (three comeback wins from a set down in Toronto)

H2H 6-6. Final today at 6 PM ET. 🎾

#WTA #Tennis #NBO2026

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Rybakina has come from a set down to win three times in Toronto. Three times.

She faces Swiatek in the final tonight at 6 PM ET. H2H tied 6-6.

This is the best women's final of the summer. 🎾

#WTA #Tennis #NBO2026 #Toronto

stories.title: Nakashima Into His First Masters Final — UVA Cavalier Beats Fellow Cavalier [TIER 2]

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Brandon Nakashima reached his first-ever ATP Masters 1000 final today.

11 aces in 1h17m vs. Darderi (QF). Then outlasted Jodar 7-6(3), 6-4 (SF).

The 28th seed is in the final. Tonight vs. Shelton in Montreal. 🎾
